title: An overriding method must not widen the return type its parent documents

ground_truth.statement: Shelter::adopt() documents @return Dog and BadShelter::adopt() documents @return Animal, returning a Cat. PHP enforces only the native signature (Animal -> Animal is legal), so the widening is silent until a caller that believes the parent's contract calls a Dog-only method: wake(new BadShelter()) throws Error because Cat has no bark(). The override is therefore not assignable to the parent contract it claims to implement.

phpstan.reason: In this baseline configuration PHPStan deliberately suppresses maybe-compatible PHPDoc override checks: reportMaybesInMethodSignatures defaults to false. MethodSignatureRule emits method.childReturnType for this widening only with that optional flag enabled. This is an excluded configuration-scope difference, not evidence that PHPStan lacks the rule.

notes: Psalm 6.20.0 (LessSpecificImplementedReturnType) and Mago 1.57.0 (incompatible-return-type) report the widened override. PHPStan 2.3.1 is silent at the baseline level-9 configuration because reportMaybesInMethodSignatures is false (conf/config.neon:100). Its MethodSignatureRule explicitly gates maybe-compatible overrides on that option. Enabling the option yields method.childReturnType; therefore its baseline silence is a documented configuration-scope divergence, excluded from the defect denominator. The fixture and runtime consequence remain unchanged: wake(new BadShelter()) throws when the widened override breaks the parent's PHPDoc contract. The benchmark records both the concrete program defect and which configured checks promise to diagnose it.

sources.note: Psalm documents the rule with an interface-implementation example

OverridingMethodRule.php line 376 gates the PHPDoc signature rule; MethodSignatureRule.php reports a maybe compatibility only when reportMaybesInMethodSignatures is true, and conf/config.neon line 100 sets it false (conf/config.level3.neon line 9 turns checkPhpDocMethodSignatures on)
